rules.description: Directly Map F8 to Spotify (Overrides fn_function_keys)

to.shell_command: if ! pgrep -x "Spotify" > /dev/null; then open -a "Spotify"; else osascript -e 'tell application "Spotify" to playpause'; fi
echo 'Triggered f9 rule' >> /tmp/karabiner_test.log; if ! pgrep -x "Spotify" > /dev/null; then open -a "Spotify"; else osascript -e 'tell application "Spotify" to playpause'; fi
echo 'Triggered f8 rule' >> /tmp/karabiner_test.log; if ! pgrep -x "Spotify" > /dev/null; then open -a "Spotify"; else osascript -e 'tell application "Spotify" to playpause'; fi
echo 'Triggered play_or_pause' >> /tmp/karabiner_test.log; if ! pgrep -x "Spotify" > /dev/null; then open -a "Spotify"; else osascript -e 'tell application "Spotify" to playpause'; fi
